product.tagline: 把多项目开发、构建与联调集中到一个本地工作台。
product.description: 在一个界面里管理工作区、项目、分支、构建、资源入口、本地代理和执行记录，让常用开发操作更集中，状态与失败原因更容易核对。
nonGoals: 替代 GitLab、Jenkins 或现有 CI/CD 平台
托管团队密钥、远端凭据或业务源代码
在没有计划和确认的情况下执行高风险发布动作

facts.label: 执行保障
facts.value: 计划 / 确认 / 记录

capabilities.title: 工作区与项目
capabilities.body: 在全局视图和需求工作区之间切换，集中查看当前范围内的项目、实例目录、分支与常用入口。

capabilities.title: 资源与通用 Action
capabilities.body: 集中打开网站、目录、应用和脚本；运行 Action 前查看固定上下文与参数，执行中可看日志、取消任务或重试失败项目。

capabilities.title: 分支与 Git 操作
capabilities.body: 检查分支状态，完成同步、创建、切换、合并和推送；批量记录按项目展示，并直接说明权限不足或合并冲突。

capabilities.title: 构建与部署
capabilities.body: 选择项目和构建目标，确认分支与环境参数后触发任务；构建记录保留参数、进度、结果链接和失败原因。

capabilities.title: 代理与本地联调
capabilities.body: 管理本地代理、Mock、转发与运行服务，通过 Link 组合常用联调步骤，并随时核对进程和端口状态。

capabilities.title: 记录、知识与诊断
capabilities.body: 在 Record 中查找历史动作、展开项目详情并重试可恢复任务；知识库保存项目经验，诊断页检查环境与配置问题。

capabilities.title: 配置迁移与回滚
capabilities.body: 按项目、工作区和资源配置源导出可移植配置包；导入前检查路径与冲突计划，执行时保留整批事务备份。

workflow.label: 进入
workflow.title: 选择当前工作区
workflow.body: 先选择系统全局视图或当前需求工作区，确认需要操作的项目范围。

workflow.label: 检查
workflow.title: 检查项目与运行状态
workflow.body: 查看分支、构建目标、代理、运行服务和最近记录，确认当前状态是否适合继续。

workflow.label: 执行
workflow.title: 先计划，再运行
workflow.body: 构建、Git、Link 与远程写入 Action 会先展示范围、参数和风险，通过确认后再执行。

workflow.label: 复盘
workflow.title: 查看结果并处理失败
workflow.body: 在 Record 中查看每个项目的结果、明确错误和结果链接，并对支持的任务重新执行。

boundary.title: 配置与记录留在本机，远程动作始终可见
boundary.body: rDevTool 不替代 GitLab、Jenkins 或现有 CI/CD。连接信息来自本地环境或私有配置，推送、合并、构建和部署前会展示操作范围，并在完成后保留结果。

product.tagline: Bring multi-project development, builds, and local debugging into one workbench.
product.description: Manage workspaces, projects, branches, builds, resources, local proxies, and execution records in one interface, with states and failure reasons that are easy to review.
nonGoals: Replace GitLab, Jenkins, or an existing CI/CD platform
Host team secrets, remote credentials, or business source code
Run high-risk release actions without a visible plan and confirmation

capabilities.title: Workspaces and projects
capabilities.body: Switch between the global view and requirement workspaces to see the projects, instance folders, branches, and resources in your current scope.

capabilities.title: Resources and reusable Actions
capabilities.body: Open websites, folders, apps, and scripts from one place. Review context and parameters before an Action, then watch logs, cancel, or retry failed items.

capabilities.title: Branches and Git operations
capabilities.body: Inspect branch state, sync, create, switch, merge, and push. Batch records show one row per project with clear permission or merge-conflict errors.

capabilities.title: Builds and deployments
capabilities.body: Choose projects and build targets, confirm branch and environment parameters, then trigger the job. Build records keep progress, links, parameters, and failure reasons.

capabilities.title: Proxies and local debugging
capabilities.body: Manage local proxies, mocks, forwarding rules, and running services. Use Links for repeatable debugging steps and verify process and port status at any time.

capabilities.title: Records, knowledge, and diagnostics
capabilities.body: Search past work in Record, expand project details, and retry recoverable tasks. Keep project notes in the knowledge library and check setup issues in Diagnostics.

capabilities.title: Configuration transfer and rollback
capabilities.body: Export portable packs by project, workspace, and resource source. Review path mappings and conflict plans before applying with a complete transaction backup.

workflow.label: Enter
workflow.title: Choose the current workspace
workflow.body: Choose the global system view or the requirement workspace you are working in, then confirm the project scope.

workflow.label: Inspect
workflow.title: Check projects and running state
workflow.body: Review branches, build targets, proxies, running services, and recent records before choosing the next action.

workflow.label: Execute
workflow.title: Plan first, then run
workflow.body: Build, Git, Link, and remote-write Actions show their scope, parameters, and risks before execution.

workflow.label: Review
workflow.title: Review results and resolve failures
workflow.body: Use Record to inspect per-project results, clear errors, and result links, then rerun tasks that support retry.

boundary.title: Configuration and records stay local, and remote actions stay visible
boundary.body: rDevTool does not replace GitLab, Jenkins, or your CI/CD. Connection details come from local environment or private configuration, and push, merge, build, and deployment actions show their scope before running and keep the result afterward.

website.releaseSummary: The current preview covers workspace and project management, branches and builds, reusable Actions, proxies and local debugging, the knowledge library, diagnostics, and unified Records, with clear errors, cancellation, and failed-task retry.

cli.highRiskPolicy: 构建、部署、远程写入 Action、合并、推送、工作区复制、配置导入和配置写入优先执行 plan、overview、status 或 dry-run，再由用户确认。

runtime.secretPolicy: 敏感信息使用环境变量、系统凭据或不入库的私有本地配置，不应进入仓库模板、一次性命令参数和机器可读诊断。
